allowed: Integrate AI Services through the documented API with an authorized token; usage is billed by consumption.
Review generated content and respect the applicable model licenses and integration rights.
forbidden: Do not hack or bypass service controls, overload the service, or violate applicable laws.

retention: Request content is held temporarily for processing. Billing and operational data are retained; the LLM terms do not specify a universal retention period.
training: The LLM terms state that transmitted prompts and responses are not used to train Infomaniak AI models.
